                throw new ArgumentException($"Value ({email.Length} characters) exceeds customers.email max length (200).", nameof(email));

// <auto-generated/>
#nullable enable

using System;

namespace Extrode.JauntyQ.Generated
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Thrown when the database returns an enum value the schema snapshot
    /// does not contain — almost always because the type gained a member
    /// after the snapshot was pulled. Re-pull the schema and rebuild.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class JauntyQEnumValueException : InvalidOperationException
    {
        public JauntyQEnumValueException(string enumType, string column, string value)
            : base("Database value '" + value + "' for column '" + column + "' is not a member of enum '" + enumType +
                   "' as captured in the schema snapshot. Re-pull the schema (jaunty schema pull) and rebuild.")
        {
            EnumType = enumType;
            Column = column;
            Value = value;
        }

        /// <summary>The captured enum type the value did not belong to.</summary>
        public string EnumType { get; }

        /// <summary>The column the value was read from, as "table.column".</summary>
        public string Column { get; }

        /// <summary>The verbatim value the database returned.</summary>
        public string Value { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>Database enum 'customer_status'. Member order matches the database's own.</summary>
    public enum CustomerStatus
    {
        /// <summary>Wire value <c>active</c>.</summary>
        Active,
        /// <summary>Wire value <c>on hold</c>.</summary>
        OnHold,
        /// <summary>Wire value <c>closed</c>.</summary>
        Closed,
    }

    /// <summary>Wire-value conversion for <see cref="CustomerStatus"/>.</summary>
    public static class CustomerStatusValues
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Converts a database value to its member. <paramref name="column"/> is
        /// only used to name the offender if the value is unknown.
        /// </summary>
        public static CustomerStatus Parse(string value, string column)
        {
            switch (value)
            {
                case "active":
                    return CustomerStatus.Active;
                case "on hold":
                    return CustomerStatus.OnHold;
                case "closed":
                    return CustomerStatus.Closed;
                default:
                    throw new JauntyQEnumValueException("customer_status", column, value);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Converts a member back to the value the database stores.</summary>
        public static string ToWire(CustomerStatus value)
        {
            switch (value)
            {
                case CustomerStatus.Active:
                    return "active";
                case CustomerStatus.OnHold:
                    return "on hold";
                case CustomerStatus.Closed:
                    return "closed";
                default:
                    throw new JauntyQEnumValueException("customer_status", "customer_status", value.ToString());
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Data;
using System.Data.Common;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Extrode.JauntyQ.Generated
{
    public class JauntyDb
    {
        private readonly DbConnection _conn;
        private DbTransaction? _tx;
        private bool _txOpenedConnection;

        public JauntyDb(DbConnection conn) => _conn = conn;

        internal DbConnection Connection => _conn;
        internal DbTransaction? CurrentTransaction => _tx;

        /// <summary>
        /// Opens the connection if needed and starts a transaction. Every
        /// db.* call automatically enlists until Commit/Rollback/Dispose;
        /// if the connection was opened here it is closed when the
        /// transaction ends. Dispose without Commit rolls back.
        /// </summary>
        public Transaction BeginTransaction()
        {
            if (_tx != null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("A JauntyDb transaction is already active.");
            bool openedNow = _conn.State != ConnectionState.Open;
            if (openedNow) _conn.Open();
            try
            {
                _tx = _conn.BeginTransaction();
            }
            catch
            {
                // A failed BeginTransaction must not leave a dangling "we opened
                // it" claim behind: if we opened the connection for this attempt,
                // close it again so a retry on this instance starts from a clean
                // slate instead of silently losing track of who opened it.
                if (openedNow) _conn.Close();
                throw;
            }
            _txOpenedConnection = openedNow;
            return new Transaction(this, _tx);
        }

        public async Task<Transaction> BeginTransactionAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (_tx != null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("A JauntyDb transaction is already active.");
            bool openedNow = _conn.State != ConnectionState.Open;
            if (openedNow) await _conn.OpenAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            try
            {
                _tx = await _conn.BeginTransactionAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch
            {
                if (openedNow) _conn.Close();
                throw;
            }
            _txOpenedConnection = openedNow;
            return new Transaction(this, _tx);
        }

        private void EndTransaction()
        {
            _tx = null;
            if (_txOpenedConnection && _conn.State != ConnectionState.Closed)
                _conn.Close();
            _txOpenedConnection = false;
        }

        public sealed class Transaction : IDisposable
        {
            private readonly JauntyDb _db;
            private DbTransaction? _inner;

            internal Transaction(JauntyDb db, DbTransaction inner)
            {
                _db = db;
                _inner = inner;
            }

            public void Commit()
            {
                if (_inner == null)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Transaction already completed.");
                _inner.Commit();
                End();
            }

            public void Rollback()
            {
                if (_inner == null)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Transaction already completed.");
                _inner.Rollback();
                End();
            }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (_inner == null) return;
                End(); // disposing an uncommitted DbTransaction rolls back
            }

            private void End()
            {
                _inner!.Dispose();
                _inner = null;
                _db.EndTransaction();
            }
        }

==== JauntyQShapeGuard.g.cs
// <auto-generated/>
#nullable enable

namespace Extrode.JauntyQ.Generated
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Validates the result-set shape against the schema snapshot. The caller
    /// latches this so it runs on the first execution of each query per process
    /// and never again (never per row, never per subsequent call). Catches drift
    /// between the live database and the snapshot instead of silently mapping
    /// wrong ordinals.
    /// </summary>
    public static class JauntyQShapeGuard
    {
        public static void Validate(System.Data.Common.DbDataReader reader, string[] expectedColumns, string queryId)
        {
            if (reader.FieldCount < expectedColumns.Length)
            {
                throw new System.InvalidOperationException(
                    $"JauntyQ schema drift in {queryId}: expected {expectedColumns.Length} columns but the result set has {reader.FieldCount}. " +
                    "The database no longer matches the schema snapshot; re-run 'jaunty schema pull' and rebuild.");
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < expectedColumns.Length; i++)
            {
                string actual = reader.GetName(i);
                if (!string.Equals(actual, expectedColumns[i], System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    throw new System.InvalidOperationException(
                        $"JauntyQ schema drift in {queryId}: expected column '{expectedColumns[i]}' at ordinal {i} but the result set returned '{actual}'. " +
                        "The database no longer matches the schema snapshot; re-run 'jaunty schema pull' and rebuild.");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
